author: ojiudezue
title: Soak Exit rule — shipped_organic is not a parking lot; dispose via one-shot ground-truth query, never endless soak
summary: The organic lane had piled to 46 cards — things ship, go shipped_organic, and ride forever with no exit, which the operator called out as effing slow. New MANDATORY rule: every organic card carries a binary discriminator and gets a bounded validate-then-DISPOSE window; validation is a one-shot query against the authoritative source (URA DB table, live entity, ground truth) AT disposition time, not a calendar watch. Met-with-residual = close the primary done + card the tail. Un-evaluable discriminator => convert to a code trip-wire or park with a trigger, not organic. Forcing sweep at every deploy + session start.
why: An organic card with no forcing function is indistinguishable from a dropped one, so the backlog grows and the cycle feels slow. Proven same session: HVAC-GOVERNED-EXCURSION-1 (soaking since 08-23) was disposed to done in ONE ssh-sqlite3 cross-tab of ac_ramp_events (99 immediate restores, H1 met; 24 delayed-poll artifacts vs only 4 real failures) — not another week of watching. This is the sister of the pre-existing No-Soak-Watching rule, applied to disposition rather than to acceptance monitoring.
implications: Codified in CLAUDE.md 'Soak Exit — MANDATORY' + memory feedback_soak_exit_forcing_function. Drove a live disposition sweep: HVAC-GOVERNED-EXCURSION-1 -> done (4-restore-fail tail carded); BORROW-BANKING confirmed failure-mode-a via DB (banking never ends: 2 open state rows / 0 ended events); HVAC-MANUAL confirmed self-lockout (should_change_preset returns False on manual) + banking-doesnt-restore; S14 unblocked. KEY: BORROW + HVAC-MANUAL + S14 are ONE excursion-restore family (every raw-setpoint excursion needs a bounded ending that restores a preset) — consolidated into PLANNING_hvac_excursion_restore_unified.md (Tier 3, D2-before-D3), replacing three separate cycles.
revisit_trigger: If the organic lane grows past ~10 again without a disposition sweep, the forcing hooks aren't firing — tighten them.
supersedes: Extends feedback_no_soak (No Soak Watching) from acceptance-monitoring to card disposition.
